claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue reached a second consecutive quarterly record at $1.329B, up 104% year over year, with record Memory revenue and management citing AI-related test demand.

factors.name: AI semiconductor test bottleneck
factors.basis: Record semiconductor-test and memory demand ties Teradyne to rising AI device complexity.

risks.risk: Semiconductor test is cyclical and current memory/AI strength can normalize sharply.

causalEdges.mechanism: more complex devices and packaging require more validation and test content
causalEdges.falsifier: test intensity per device falls or competitors gain share

unknowns.unknown: Robotics revenue was only $100M in Q2, so the robotics narrative should remain distinct from the much larger test business.

claims.claim: Q2 revenue exceeded the high end of guidance and non-GAAP EPS reached $2.47 versus $0.57 a year earlier; Q3 revenue guidance of $1.2B-$1.3B implies a high but somewhat lower sequential range after the record quarter.

factors.name: Execution versus expectations
factors.basis: Revenue exceeded guidance and earnings scaled strongly.

risks.risk: Record results create difficult comparisons and Q3 guide allows sequential normalization.

causalEdges.mechanism: higher utilization and mix lift test-system sales and operating leverage
causalEdges.falsifier: memory capex or AI test demand retrenches

unknowns.unknown: No canonical valuation conclusion is asserted.
